cohort: The study involved 108 placenta samples collected from pregnant women, categorized by pre-pregnancy BMI, BMI at term, and gestational weight gain.
finding: Placental Bcl-2 expression was significantly higher in obese pregnant women (based on BMI at the end of pregnancy), and Pim-1 expression was significantly higher in women with excessive gestational weight gain, demonstrating the impact of maternal weight on placental anti-apoptotic and inflammatory processes.
